claims.claim: Release policy is immutable after consent
claims.publicWording: Tested locally: once another member consents, the contract rejects any change to the rule.
claims.notes: Invariant suite found and fixed a capacity-shrink bug before any deployment (DECISIONS.md D-009).

claims.requiredEvidence: Failed testnet transaction and verifier trace
claims.publicWording: Observed on BOT Chain testnet: an early release attempt reverted on-chain with RuleNotSatisfied, and the verifier trace shows release was recorded only after the rule was true.
claims.notes: Testnet proof run 2026-09-23, step 4. The run used two wallets generated by the build agent, not non-developer participants (PRD §15.3 still requires that run). The full §14 campaign on testnet (adversarial:testnet) is still to run.

claims.claim: The capsule lifecycle is independently replayable
claims.requiredEvidence: Published verifier output against deployed contract
claims.publicWording: Verified on BOT Chain testnet: the open-source verifier replayed every capsule on the deployed registry from the public RPC — all VALID, bytecode matching the audited build — without Relay's servers.
claims.notes: pnpm verify:testnet, 2026-09-23 (the optional delivery-signature check read the build-machine storage). The run used two wallets generated by the build agent, not non-developer participants (PRD §15.3 still requires that run).

claims.claim: Member payload is absent from contract events
claims.earliestWording: The protocol does not store plaintext payload on-chain
claims.requiredEvidence: ABI/event inspection and testnet proof run
claims.publicWording: The protocol does not store plaintext payload on-chain: contract events carry only ids, addresses, counts, timestamps and 32-byte hashes, and the BOT Chain testnet proof run found no plaintext in any registry event.
claims.notes: ABI inspection test + testnet proof run step 3 (log scan for the plaintext, caption and file name). The run used two wallets generated by the build agent, not non-developer participants (PRD §15.3 still requires that run).

claims.requiredEvidence: Address, verified source, explorer link, deployment transaction
claims.publicWording: Deployed on BOT Chain testnet at 0x6f6e2c0fb44016d621e133612c61069de15cd710 (block 24389826), source verified on BOTScan.
claims.notes: Gate T2 passed 2026-09-23: deployment tx, Blockscout source verification, runtime bytecode sha256 matches the build, relayer keys registered on-chain.

claims.requiredEvidence: Mainnet address, verified source, and deployment transaction
claims.publicWording: No mainnet deployment. Mainnet is gated by T0–T6 and owner authorisation (M0).
claims.notes: Out of scope until every testnet gate passes.

claims.claim: Threshold release prevents all early disclosure
claims.requiredEvidence: The model has a stated collusion and creator-retention limit (§6)
claims.publicWording: Relay does not claim this. A colluding threshold of relayers could disclose early, and contributors can keep their own copies.
